## Summary

Consolidated the server-side `ai-os/OWNER_DIRECTIVES/` from 7 scattered files into exactly one protocol file and one memory file, with real software enforcement:

**Final live state (6 files):**
- `PROTOCOL_OWNER_AI.yaml`, `MEMORY_OWNER_AI.yaml` — the two new canonical files
- **Deleted** (zero citations found anywhere): `STANDING_OPERATING_PROTOCOL_2026-07-26.yaml`, `OWNER_ASSISTANT_RUNBOOK_2026-07-26.yaml`, `TASK_LIFECYCLE_STATE_MACHINE_2026-07-26.yaml`
- **Retained** with superseded-by headers (real exact-path citations confirmed in `MASTER_INDEX.yaml`, `WIRING_ENGINE_REGISTRY_2026-07-25.json`, `VERIDIAN_ARCHITECTURE_V2_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-25.yaml`, etc.): `OWNER_ENGINE_MANDATORY_GATE_2026-07-25.txt`, `CHATGPT_AUDIT_AND_PROMPT_LIBRARY_WORKSPACE_2026-07-24.txt`, `WIRING_ENGINE_SOFTWARE_2026-07-24.txt`, `BROWSER_NATIVE_END_USER_ARCHITECTURE_2026-07-25.txt`

**Software mechanism:** `scripts/check_single_protocol_file.py` enforces exactly-one-of-each going forward via a real document-signature check, wired into `scripts/preflight-guard.py` (runs before every task dispatch). Tested both pass and fail cases with a real temp duplicate.

**Bonus finding:** while validating with `yaml.safe_load` (as the task required), discovered the original `STANDING_OPERATING_PROTOCOL_2026-07-26.yaml` source file itself was invalid YAML — never caught before this consolidation.

Both files registered in the knowledge_engine and `MASTER_INDEX.yaml registries.owner_ai_protocol` (git + live copies). Committed, pushed, and opened **PR #77**: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/77 — awaiting review/merge.
